technical_and_design_decisions: All documentation deliverables will be stored in the official Hyperledger Fabric documentation repository, versioned in sync with code releases to ensure alignment between documentation and implementation.

Target audiences for documentation and demo materials have baseline familiarity with blockchain concepts and Hyperledger Fabric fundamentals, so no introductory blockchain content is required.
